WITH account_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_order_count FROM account_orders
),
account_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.account_id,
    ao.region,
    ao.order_count,
    (ao.order_count - oa.avg_order_count) as diff_from_overall
  FROM account_orders ao
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
region_avg_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    AVG(diff_from_overall) as region_avg_diff
  FROM account_diffs
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  ad.account_id,
  ad.region,
  ad.order_count,
  ad.diff_from_overall,
  (ad.diff_from_overall - rad.region_avg_diff) as excess_over_region_avg
FROM account_diffs ad
JOIN region_avg_diffs rad ON ad.region = rad.region
WHERE ad.diff_from_overall > rad.region_avg_diff
ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
